Whistleblower Tip Form

The California Whistleblower Protection Act requires that we keep every investigation confidential, including the
identity of the complainant. It also does not grant us enforcement authority. Therefore, we cannot assist individuals in
providing remedies or resolving disputes individuals have with a state agency or state employee. Some examples
include retaliation claims, discrimination claims, harassment claims, court judgments, or employment benefits.
